scope: Additional voice skills linked to their original maintained repositories or, for vendors that publish only on their documentation sites, to the published skill file. Counts include language variants and explicitly marked optional workflows. No third-party content is copied by this index.

selection_definitions.recommended: Provider-owned or clearly maintained source; directly useful for building or operating voice agents; substantive, not a thin wrapper.
selection_definitions.optional-provider-workflow: Provider-specific operational workflow with a narrower audience.
selection_definitions.optional-reference: Reference material or a pointer-style skill.
selection_definitions.optional-migration: Moving an existing agent or integration between providers or models.
selection_definitions.optional-prerelease: Alpha or beta features or still-unstable APIs.
selection_definitions.optional-deployment: Self-hosting or deployment guidance for a provider's product.
selection_definitions.optional-evaluation: Simulation, test authoring, scoring and monitoring of voice agents.
selection_definitions.optional-webhooks: Webhook signature verification and handlers for voice or telephony providers.
selection_definitions.optional-speech-api: Single speech-to-text, text-to-speech or diarization API skills that are a component rather than an agent workflow.
selection_definitions.optional-security: Account, authentication, compliance or hardening guidance for telephony providers.
selection_definitions.optional-client-sdk: Client-side or embedded SDK skills (browser, mobile, WebRTC rooms).

date_semantics: Source dates are repository HEAD commit dates, not per-skill last modification dates. Stars are repository counts observed at the listed retrieval time. Docs-hosted skills have no commit: each is pinned by the sha256 of the file and the retrieval time. Their Last-Modified header is recorded but is not treated as a modification date.
docs_hosted_note: Docs-hosted skills are single skill files that vendor documentation sites serve through /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json (Agent Skills discovery). Each index entry carries a sha256 digest; all selected files returned HTTP 200 and matched their digest at retrieval.
